2607.29621.title: CENDRe: Concept Extraction with Natural Domain Representations
2607.29621.paper_summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for time-series classification, but their deployment in critical domains requires understanding the temporal and spectral patterns that drive their predictions. Concept extraction (CE) methods identify such patterns by analyzing representations within the models' latent space. However, existing time-series CE methods have three limitations: they operate only in the time domain and overlook frequency features, predefine the number of concepts, and produce localizations misaligned with the regions the model uses. We address these limitations by proposing CENDRe, a concept extraction method for CNNs. It first discovers concepts by clustering per-timestep latent representations in two stages, where silhouette-guided aggregation selects the number of concepts automatically. Then, it localizes each concept through gradients of a presence score that contrasts the latent representations with their prototypes, producing masks that concentrate on the regions driving the concept. These gradients, propagated through a differentiable invertible mapping of the input such as a Fourier transform, yield localizations for the same concepts in the frequency domain. Finally, each concept receives a relevance score that quantifies its contribution to each class. On synthetic benchmarks, CENDRe achieves representation correctness comparable to state-of-the-art CE methods and significantly higher importance correctness. On real bearing-fault data, CENDRe extracts the frequency bands driving the model's predictions, located in regions commonly inspected for fault diagnosis, producing evidence to assess the model that time-domain CE methods cannot.
2607.29621.paper_summary_zh: 卷積神經網絡（CNNs）廣泛應用於時間序列分類，但在關鍵領域的部署需要理解驅動其預測的時間和頻譜模式。概念提取（CE）方法通過分析模型潛在空間中的表示來識別這些模式。然而，現有的時間序列CE方法存在三個限制：它們僅在時間域內運作，忽略頻率特徵，預先定義概念的數量，並且產生與模型使用的區域不對齊的定位。我們通過提出CENDRe，一種針對CNN的概念提取方法來解決這些限制。它首先通過在兩個階段中對每個時間步的潛在表示進行聚類來發現概念，其中輪廓引導的聚合自動選擇概念的數量。然後，它通過與原型對比的存在分數的梯度來定位每個概念，產生集中於驅動該概念的區域的掩膜。這些梯度通過可微分的可逆映射（如傅立葉變換）傳播，為頻率域中的相同概念產生定位。最後，每個概念獲得一個相關性分數，量化其對每個類別的貢獻。在合成基準測試中，CENDRe實現了與最先進的CE方法相當的表示正確性，並顯著提高了重要性正確性。在實際的軸承故障數據中，CENDRe提取了驅動模型預測的頻率帶，位於常見的故障診斷檢查區域，提供了評估模型的證據，而時間域CE方法無法做到這一點。
